demonstrated_defects: Public routing/export on every before hook continually grew the pool and postponed the method action.
After-step source consolidation could also expand background work during the selected segment.
Public-before native was counted as the learned method attempt even with empty actual_action_content.
Structure planning used the native operator name and must not end the unit before its Q.
Final complete comparison alone could set execution_complete when the registered native attempt never ran.
Qeval could be acquired when only one of the paired outputs existed.

repair.phase_storage: existing research_organization.registered_method_unit, keyed to actual path and invocation origin
repair.public_preparation: one bounded ordinary consolidation/routing/export visit; never claims the full library search finished
repair.comparison: actual exact-question/meaning/current-row complete strong-pool reports produce choice_ready; no candidate deletion
repair.research: normal parent/child settling and binding maintenance remain; unrelated automatic routing/export/consolidation is deferred to the next unit
repair.scope_changes: changed meaning/context/role/unit or frozen parent binding stops the old unit with requires_rebind and preserves costs; Q row extension updates its ordinary consumer and requires current-row comparison without restarting background library research
repair.budget: Preserve max(registered planned_native_compute, complete candidate quote bounded_research_compute), so a small first planning price cannot release the following native core; original routing allocation remains clamped within the held complete-core and closure budget.
repair.native_boundary: only native fitting returned from the program action/callback counts; public native and structure_planning do not
repair.delivery: native-limit contracts without an actual attempt keep complete comparison/old parent but report preparation_only and execution_complete=false
repair.evaluation_lifecycle: all outputs must freeze before any shared Qeval acquisition/evaluation; actual lifecycle is written into frozen manifest and paired evidence
repair.retained_pool_scope: A cutoff before final comparison reports the actual retained full roster, not zero from an unfilled local variable.

actual_paid_scope_validation.validation_kind: thin metadata projection of real paid scope into existing stage consumer, not full-agent restoration or a new method experiment
